# Prime Pets

> Prime Pets is an online pet store offering premium pet food, accessories, grooming products, and toys for dogs, cats, and other pets.

## About

Prime Pets provides a curated selection of high-quality pet products, competitive pricing, and a seamless shopping experience. We serve pet owners who want the best for their animals.

## Pages

- [Home](https://primepets.vercel.app/) - Main storefront with featured products, deals, and categories
- [Shop](https://primepets.vercel.app/shop) - Browse all products
- [Offers](https://primepets.vercel.app/offers) - Current deals and discounts
- [Categories](https://primepets.vercel.app/category) - Browse by pet category
- [Hub](https://primepets.vercel.app/hub) - Pet care tips and resources
- [Account](https://primepets.vercel.app/account) - Customer account management

## Products

Prime Pets stocks products across these categories:
- Pet food and nutrition
- Grooming and hygiene
- Toys and enrichment
- Accessories and gear
- Health and wellness

## Contact

For orders and inquiries, contact us via WhatsApp through the website chat.
